'''Darth Phobos's lightsaber''' was a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|saberstaff]] used by the [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Phobos]] during her life.

==Legacy==
[[File:StarkillerfightsPhobos.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Darth Phobos as a hologram, dueling Galen Marek during his mission to the Jedi Temple]]
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] [[Starkiller's Trial of Insight|sent]] his [[Sith apprentice|secret apprentice]] [[Galen Marek]], code-named Starkiller, to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to face the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trial of Insight]]. After fighting through the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison located at the temple, he dueled a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] manifestation of Phobos wielding her double-bladed lightsaber. Despite catching him off guard by disguising herself as [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] before brandishing the blade, she was ultimately defeated by the [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]]. By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the technical readout of the lightsaber that Phobos had used during her life came into possession of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Alliance [[Staff Sergeant/Legends|Staff Sergeant]] [[Levardio]], stationed on the [[Zephyr Base]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], offered the readout for sale to Rebels who performed valiantly on the battlefields of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], allowing the buyer to create their own replica of Phobos' lightsaber after acquiring all the necessary resources.
